AUTHOR: Zhang
TITLE: An Improved YOLOv8n Used for Fish Detection in Natural Water Environments
REGION: Moreton Bay, Queensland, Australia; Høyegga and Myggbukta, Inlandet, Norway
SPECIES: Australasian snapper, blue catfish, eastern striped grunter, paradise threadfin bream, smallmouth scad, smooth golden toadfish, yellowfin bream, bleak, perch
DATA: Moreton Bay BRUV estuarine poor-visibility dataset (Lopez-Marcano et al., Zenodo 5238512) + NINA/NTNU Norwegian freshwater fish video data; ~2000 selected images
V_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'baited underwater video setup at a depth of 2–5 m ... under natural lighting conditions ... water visibility limited to the measured Secchi depth.'
D_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'we deleted highly similar images in the original dataset' and 'randomly divided into a training set and a test set using random sampling in a 7:3 ratio.'
R_EV: Sec. 4.4: 'the dataset constructed by this study was used for testing' (single pooled dataset, random split)
C_EV: Sec. 4.6: 'the confidence threshold was set to 0.25.' (no justification or FP/duplicate handling)
METR: precision, recall, mAP@50, mAP@50:95, per-class AP, confusion matrix
NOTE: Secchi depth is mentioned ('visibility limited to the measured Secchi depth') but no value reported, so V1 coded 정성 서술만 not Secchi; verifier check. Norwegian NINA data platform not described (PLAT 혼합). Near-duplicate removal stated as overfitting control, not leakage discussion (D4=N). Target size distribution described but no size-stratified performance reported (E4=없음). Code on request; data from public sources. Duplicate counting mentioned only as future work.
AUTHORS_FULL: Zhang, ZH; Qu, Y; Wang, T; Rao, Y; Jiang, D; Li, SW; Wang, YT
